Botox Treatments

Forehead lines, frown lines or crow's feet making you look tired or older than you feel? Botox relaxes the tiny muscles behind expression lines so your skin smooths out, in a quick 15-minute visit with no downtime. Our doctors use precise doses for a fresher, natural look, never a frozen one.

Treatment overview

What is Botox?

Botox is a purified protein (botulinum toxin type A) that has been used safely in medicine for over 30 years. Every time you frown, squint or raise your eyebrows, small facial muscles tighten and fold the skin above them. Over the years, those folds turn into lines.

A few tiny, precise injections tell those muscles to relax. The skin on top smooths out, and new lines stop forming. Treatment takes about 15 minutes, starts working in 2 to 3 days and lasts around 3 to 4 months.

Read more: dynamic vs static wrinkles

Dynamic wrinkles show only when you move, like forehead lines when you raise your brows. Botox works brilliantly on these.

Static wrinkles are still there when your face is relaxed, because the skin has creased over time. Botox softens them, and pairing it with hydrating fillers, Profhilo or microneedling helps fill and repair the crease. That's also why starting earlier, before lines set in, gives the smoothest result.

1. BlockBotox quietens the nerve signal that tells the muscle to tighten.
2. RelaxThe muscle softens, so it stops folding the skin.
3. SmoothLines fade over 2 weeks and new ones stop forming.

Treatment areas

Where Can Botox Help? Tap the Face Map

Tap a number on the face, or pick an area from the list, to see what Botox does there, the typical units and how long it lasts.

Tap a number to see what Botox does there.

Horizontal forehead lines

The lines that appear when you raise your eyebrows. Botox softens the forehead muscle so lines fade, while keeping natural movement so you don't look surprised or frozen.

  • Smoother forehead
  • Natural eyebrow movement kept
  • Makeup sits better
Typical units10–20 units
Lasts about3–4 months

Frown lines between the brows

The "11" lines that make you look angry, worried or tired even when you're not. This is one of the most popular and effective areas for Botox.

  • Softer, more relaxed look
  • Stops deep 11s forming
  • Often the first area people treat
Typical units15–25 units
Lasts about3–4 months

Crow's feet around the eyes

Fan-shaped lines at the outer corners of the eyes that show when you smile. Small doses soften them while keeping your smile warm and natural.

  • Brighter, fresher eyes
  • Natural smile kept
  • Pairs well with forehead and frown lines
Typical units12–24 units (both sides)
Lasts about3–4 months

Non-surgical brow lift

A few carefully placed units lift the tail of the eyebrows, opening up the eyes and making heavy or drooping brows look lighter.

  • More open, awake eyes
  • Subtle arch to the brows
  • No surgery
Typical units4–10 units
Lasts about3–4 months

Bunny lines on the nose

Little lines on the sides of the nose that appear when you scrunch up your face or laugh. Often treated together with frown lines.

  • Smoother nose bridge
  • Quick add-on area
Typical units4–10 units
Lasts about3–4 months

Gummy smile and lip flip

A tiny dose relaxes the upper lip muscle so less gum shows when you smile, or so the upper lip rolls out slightly to look a little fuller.

  • Less gum on show
  • Slightly fuller-looking upper lip
  • Very small, precise doses
Typical units2–6 units
Lasts about2–3 months

Dimpled or "orange peel" chin

An overactive chin muscle can make the chin look bumpy or dimpled. Botox relaxes it for a smoother chin.

  • Smoother chin
  • Softer lower face
Typical units4–10 units
Lasts about3–4 months

Jaw slimming and teeth grinding

Strong masseter (chewing) muscles make the face look square and wide. Botox slims them over a few weeks for a softer, more V-shaped face, and often helps with teeth grinding and jaw tension too.

  • Slimmer, softer jawline
  • Less clenching and grinding
  • Results build over 4 to 8 weeks
Typical units40–60 units (both sides)
Lasts about4–6 months

Neck bands

Vertical bands on the neck from the platysma muscle can make the neck look older. Botox relaxes them and can give a subtle lift along the jawline.

  • Smoother neck
  • Sharper jawline
  • Pairs well with jaw slimming
Typical units20–40 units
Lasts about3–4 months

Beyond wrinkles

Medical Uses of Botox

Botox isn't only cosmetic. These treatments are planned by our doctors after a full assessment.

Excessive sweating

Sweating through shirts even in an air-conditioned room is a medical condition called hyperhidrosis. Botox in the underarms switches off overactive sweat glands for months.

  • Dry underarms for 4 to 6 months, often longer
  • No more sweat patches
  • Can also treat palms and feet
Typical units50 units per underarm
Lasts about4–6+ months

Migraine & tension headaches

For chronic migraine, Botox can reduce how often headaches happen. This is a medical treatment planned by your doctor after a full assessment.

  • Fewer headache days for many people
  • Doctor-led medical plan
Typical unitsPlanned by your doctor

Best for: early fine lines, first-timers

Your appointment

Botox Treatment Procedure

A proper consultation comes first.

  • Your doctor talks through your concerns, goals and medical history.
  • They watch how your face moves to plan the right points and doses.
  • Avoid aspirin, ibuprofen, fish oil and vitamin E for about a week if your doctor agrees, to reduce bruising.
  • Skip alcohol for 24 hours before.
  • Come with clean skin if you can.

The injections take 10 to 20 minutes, depending on the areas.

  • Your skin is cleaned and the injection points may be marked.
  • Ice or numbing cream can be used if you're nervous.
  • Tiny amounts are injected with a very fine needle.
  • Most people feel only quick pinches.
  • Small bumps settle within 15 to 30 minutes.

You can go straight back to your day. The full aftercare plan is below.

  • Stay upright for 4 hours.
  • Don't rub, massage or press the treated areas for 24 hours.
  • Skip the gym, saunas and alcohol for 24 hours.
  • Results start in 2 to 3 days and are complete at 2 weeks.
  • Come back at 2 weeks for a review and any touch-ups.

Results

Botox Results Timeline

Botox works gradually, so you'll look refreshed rather than suddenly different.

  1. Day 2–3

    It starts working

    Muscles begin to relax and lines start to soften.

  2. Day 7–14

    Full results

    Lines look their smoothest. We review you at 2 weeks.

  3. Months 3–4

    Wears off slowly

    Movement returns gradually, with no sudden change.

  4. Repeat

    Keep it going

    Regular treatment keeps lines soft, and results often last longer over time.

Illustrative model images. Results vary from person to person.

A good fit if you

  • Have lines that show when you move your face
  • Look tired, worried or cross when you're not
  • Want to prevent lines from setting in
  • Have a square jaw, grind your teeth or sweat a lot

Not ideal if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have a nerve or muscle condition such as myasthenia gravis
  • Have an infection where you'd be treated
  • Want to fill hollows or lost volume (fillers suit that better)

Aftercare

Botox Aftercare

A few simple rules help the Botox stay exactly where it was placed.

Do

  • Stay upright
  • Gently use your treated muscles, like frowning and raising brows
  • Carry on with work or normal activities

Avoid

  • Lying down or bending over for long
  • Touching or rubbing the area
  • Wearing tight caps or headbands

Do

  • Wash your face gently
  • Use a cold pack if you have a small bruise
  • Sleep on your back if you can

Avoid

  • Facials, massages and face rollers
  • Gym, saunas and steam
  • Alcohol
  • Makeup for a few hours

Do

  • Wear sunscreen every day
  • Keep up your skincare routine
  • Come for your 2-week review

Avoid

  • Facials and laser treatments on the area
  • Firm pressure or face massage
  • Judging the result before 2 weeks

Myths vs facts

Botox Myths, Busted

"Botox will make me look frozen."
A frozen look comes from too much product in the wrong places. Our doctors use precise doses that keep your natural expressions.
"Botox is poison."
It's a highly purified medicine used in tiny, measured doses. It has been used safely in medicine for over 30 years.
"If I stop, my wrinkles will get worse."
When Botox wears off, your face returns to how it was. Lines don't get worse, and regular users often have softer lines over time.
"Botox fills wrinkles."
Botox relaxes the muscles that cause lines. Fillers are what add volume. They do different jobs and often work well together.
"Botox is only for women."
Many men have Botox for forehead lines, frown lines, jaw slimming and sweating.

Safety first

Side Effects and Who Should Wait

Botox is one of the most studied cosmetic treatments in the world. Here's what's normal and when to check with your doctor first.

Common and temporary

  • Small red marks or bumps for 15 to 30 minutes
  • Mild swelling or a small bruise
  • A mild headache on the first day
  • Rarely, a heavy brow or droopy eyelid that wears off within a few weeks

Talk to your doctor first if you

  • Are pregnant, trying to conceive or breastfeeding
  • Have myasthenia gravis or another nerve or muscle condition
  • Have an infection or active acne where you'd be treated
  • Take blood thinners or certain antibiotics
  • Had a reaction to Botox before

Questions

Botox Treatment FAQs

What is Botox?
Botox is a purified protein (botulinum toxin type A) that temporarily relaxes the muscles that cause expression lines. In tiny, precise doses, it smooths wrinkles on the forehead, between the brows and around the eyes.
Is Botox safe?
Yes, when it's given by trained doctors using genuine, approved products. It has been used in medicine for over 30 years. The doses used for wrinkles are very small and stay in the treated muscle.
Does Botox hurt?
Most people say it feels like a quick pinch. The needles are very fine and the injections take only a few minutes. Numbing cream or ice can be used if you're nervous.
When will I see results?
Botox starts working in 2 to 3 days, and full results show at about 2 weeks. Jaw slimming takes longer, about 4 to 8 weeks.
How long does Botox last?
Usually 3 to 4 months for lines on the face, and 4 to 6 months or longer for the jaw and underarm sweating. Results often last longer with regular treatments.
Will I look frozen?
No. Our doctors use precise doses to soften lines while keeping your natural expressions. You'll still be able to smile, frown and raise your brows, just with fewer lines.
How many units of Botox will I need?
It depends on the area and how strong your muscles are. As a guide, frown lines need about 15 to 25 units and the forehead 10 to 20. Use our unit estimator above, and your doctor will confirm the exact amount.
At what age should I start Botox?
There's no fixed age. Many people start in their late 20s or 30s with Baby Botox to prevent lines setting in. Others start later to soften lines they already have.
What happens when Botox wears off?
Your muscles slowly return to normal and lines come back gradually. They don't get worse than before. Many people find their lines are softer over time with regular treatment.
What's the difference between Botox and fillers?
Botox relaxes muscles to smooth lines caused by movement. Fillers add volume to fill hollows, lips and deep folds. They're often used together for a fuller refresh.
Are there any side effects?
Small red marks, mild swelling or a small bruise for a day or two are common. A mild headache can happen. A droopy eyelid or brow is rare and wears off within a few weeks.
Who should not get Botox?
Botox isn't suitable during pregnancy or breastfeeding, for people with certain nerve or muscle conditions such as myasthenia gravis, or where there's an infection in the area. Tell your doctor about all your medicines.
Can men get Botox?
Yes. Men usually have stronger muscles and may need a few more units. Forehead lines, frown lines, crow's feet and jaw slimming are popular with men.
Where can I get Botox in Kerala?
Facelit offers Botox treatments in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur).
How much does Botox cost?
Botox at Facelit is priced per unit, so you pay only for what you need. Your doctor will tell you the exact units and cost before starting.
